PALOS VERDES ESTATES, CALIFORNIA 90274
Copies of the staff reports or other written documentation relating to each item of business referred to on the agenda are on file in the office of the City Clerk and are available for public inspection. If applicable, materials related to an item on this agenda submitted to the Council after distribution of the agenda packet are available for public inspection in the City Clerk's office during normal business hours. Any person having any question concerning any agenda item may call the City Clerk to make inquiry concerning the item. Upon request, the agenda and documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the City Clerk at 310-378-0383, at least 48 hours prior to the meeting to request a disability-related modification or accommodation.
The City Council welcomes and encourages public participation at the Council meetings; however, to allow for the orderly progression of business, each person wishing to comment or make a presentation shall be limited to up to three (3) minutes. Anyone wishing to address the City Council is requested to fill out a green speaker's card available at the entry of the meeting room. The card permits the City to identify persons for purposes of City Council minute preparation. Please see specific agenda sections below for any other requirements related to meeting participation. The City Council, at the direction of the Mayor with concurrence of the Council, may modify the order of items shown on the agenda.

Via Zumaya Vehicle Speed Control
Recommended Actions:
(a) Install approximately 4,550 feet of centerline striping along the length of Via Zumaya;
(b) Add four (4) additional â€œ25â€ pavement legends along the downhill section of Via Zumaya The specific locations for the legends will be determined after a more thorough field review;
(c) Install two additional fixed-mount radar speed sign pedestals in the 1100 and 1300 blocks of Via Zumaya. The locations would then be added to the rotation of the Cityâ€™s 4 fixed-mount radar speed signs; and
(d) Continue to monitor speeds at various locations and work with residents to determine if there is a significant issue at selected locations rather than along the corridor and a more spot-oriented mitigation may be more appropriate. (4-0 in favor, Margolf absent)

306 Vista Del Mar, Suite A
Redondo Beach, CA 90277
Owner: Chris & Shannon Lennertz
Action: Approved the application (3-1 in favor; Hunter dissenting, Thomas absent) with standard conditions and the following additional conditions: 1) The proposed accessory structure shall remain outside of the 100-year flood elevation and the existing sewer easement; 2) Structures, footings, and foundations shall not be allowed in the existing sewer easement; 3) The entire accessory structure shall be lowered an additional 2 ft. The applicant may construct the wall upon receiving approval of the Miscellaneous Application.

Applicant: Douglas J. Leach, Architect
119 W. Torrance Blvd. # 24
Redondo Beach, CA 90277
Owner: Jeffrey Lin
312 E. Jefferson Blvd.
Los Angeles, CA 90011
Action: Approved the application (4-0 in favor, Thomas absent) with standard conditions and the following additional conditions: 1) A license agreement shall be submitted to defend, indemnify, and hold harmless the city, its officers, agents and employees from and against any and all loss, damage, liability, claims, demands, costs, charges, and expenses, including attorneyâ€™s fees, and causes of action of whatsoever character which the City may incur, sustain or be subjected to on account of loss or damage to property or loss of use thereof, or for bodily injury to or death of any person arising out of or in any way connected to the encroachment; and 2) A license agreement shall be submitted to reimburse the City for any costs incurred by the City to repair damage, restore premises, or satisfy claims incurred by reason of the encroachment.
e.
CDP-103-16; Consideration of a Coastal Development Permit Application for the removal of unpermitted structures within the Coastal Zone along the Lunada Bay shoreline including Rocky Shore, Resort Point, and at the stormwater outfall.
Applicant: City of Palos Verdes Estates
Action: Approved the application (4-0 in favor, Thomas absent) with standard conditions and the following additional conditions: 1) The demolition activities shall be in compliance with the recommendations contained in the geotechnical evaluation reports prepared by Geokinetics dated June 23, 2016 and September 15, 2016 for Lunada Bay; 2) A final staging and storage plan shall minimize impacts to public access during the demolition activities. A stock pile or collection site shall be established in a location that does not impact vegetation or public access. Upon completion of demolition and/or when the staging/collection site is no longer needed, the sites shall be returned to a natural state; 3) Any and all debris resulting from demolition shall be removed within a week from completion of the project; 4) No demolition or construction materials, equipment, debris, or waste shall be placed or stored where it may enter sensitive habitat, receiving waters or a storm drain, or be subject to wave, wind, rain or tidal erosion and dispersion; 5) Demolition debris and sediment shall be removed from work areas and placed in an appropriate stock pile or collection site each day that demolition occurs to prevent the accumulation of sediment and other debris that may be discharged into coastal waters; and 6) All trash and debris shall be disposed in the proper trash and recycling receptacles at the end of every construction day.
